story.title: Fort Worth plan commission approves platting waivers, closing an alley for development
story.summary: At the meeting, the commission considered residential platting requirements, commercial property redevelopment and city-owned right-of-way. The Fort Worth City Plan Commission on Thursday unanimously approved two waiver requests related to subdivisions and recommended closing public access to an alley in Council District 9 to make way for a planned community center. At its Oct. 29 meeting, the commission considered three cases involving residential platting requirements, commercial property redevelopment and city-owned right-of-way.
